description.en:
When Hinata, a female university student, starts living on her own after entering college, she finds herself in a city that’s perfectly livable but dull and boring. Thinking she’ll just spend the next four years of university here, she shrugs it off… until one day, she encounters Kage, a young man taking photos of seemingly ordinary spots around town.

Intrigued by Kage’s actions, Hinata decides to go on a city-walking adventure with him! As they stroll together, the ordinary city she once found boring begins to reveal unexpected charm… and wonders! If you walk through a seemingly mundane town with the right person, the world bursts with fascinating colors!

A city-walking romantic comedy featuring a socially savvy female university student and a young man aspiring to be a professional manga assistant!

なんでもない街を君と歩けば、世界が不思議な彩にあふれる！コミュ強女子大生×プロアシ志望青年の街あるきラブコメ！
description.pt-br:
Quando Hinata, uma universitária, começa a morar sozinha após entrar na faculdade, ela se vê em uma cidade perfeitamente habitável, mas monótona e entediante. Pensando que passará os próximos quatro anos da universidade ali, ela simplesmente ignora a situação... até que um dia encontra Kage, um jovem que tira fotos de lugares aparentemente comuns pela cidade.

Intrigada pelas ações de Kage, Hinata decide embarcar em uma aventura a pé pela cidade com ele! Enquanto passeiam juntos, a cidade comum que ela antes considerava monótona começa a revelar um charme inesperado... e maravilhas! Se você caminhar por uma cidade aparentemente banal com a pessoa certa, o mundo se enche de cores fascinantes!

Uma comédia romântica urbana que acompanha uma universitária socialmente esperta e um jovem que aspira a ser assistente de mangá!

biography.en:
Paru Itagaki (板垣 巴留, Itagaki Paru, born September 9, 1993) is a Japanese manga artist. She is best known as the creator of the manga series Beastars, for which she has won the 2018 Manga Taishō, a Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize, a Kodansha Manga Award, and a Japan Media Arts Festival Award.

Left-handed. Itagaki is highly private about her personal life and wears a chicken mask to obscure her face at all public appearances. Japanese tabloids reported in 2018 that Itagaki is the daughter of [Keisuke Itagaki](https://mangadex.org/author/53c89376-b005-4a99-ad46-f88fe2f9de1c), the creator of the manga series Baki the Grappler; the claim was repeated in April 2019 by Le Monde. Itagaki confirmed these reports in a joint interview with her father in the September 2019 issue of Weekly Shonen Champion, stating that she did not wish to disclose her parentage until she was established in the manga industry in order to avoid accusations of nepotism.

"Paru" is the pseudonym taken by his father through name divination. Keisuke Itagaki believes that using "Paru" can cause a sensation (as for why he chose the word "Paru", Keisuke  said he had forgotten).

The unlucky pair is about to experience the most horrifying “hospitality” imaginable. Meanwhile, Nero, a wildcat laborer at a farm, encounters the village's enigmatic leader, a deer-man named Ernest. Their meeting stirs something deep within Nero—a buried memory long forgotten…
description.ja: 父と娘が迷い込んだのは…"動物"の姿を纏う不気味な集団の食事会。そこでは「人間が家畜」「人肉が主菜」。《ニンゲン農場》を営む彼らは、人ならざる動物…いや、動物ならざる…ナニカ。親子は最悪の"おもてなし"を受けることになる――。一方、農場の労働者である《山猫》のネロは、この村のリーダーを務める《鹿》の男・アーネストとの邂逅により、とある記憶を取り戻すが…？戦慄の世界観、衝撃の展開の連続、あなたに問う「命を食べる」ことの意味……。
description.vi:
Một người cha và cô con gái lạc bước vào một buổi tụ họp kinh hoàng—một yến tiệc ghê rợn nơi những kẻ khoác lên mình hình hài muông thú đang say sưa tiệc tùng. Nhưng tại đây, con người lại là vật nuôi, và thịt người chính là món chính. Kẻ điều hành "nông trại người" này không hẳn là dã thú, nhưng cũng chẳng phải con người. Chúng là một thứ gì đó hoàn toàn khác. Cặp đôi bất hạnh này sắp phải trải qua sự "hiếu khách" kinh hoàng nhất có thể tưởng tượng.
Trong lúc đó, Nero, một công nhân có hình hài mèo rừng tại nông trại, lại chạm trán với Ernest, thủ lĩnh bí ẩn của ngôi làng, một kẻ mang lốt hươu. Cuộc gặp gỡ này khuấy động một điều gì đó sâu thẳm trong Nero—một ký ức bị chôn vùi đã từ lâu...
description.pt-br: O pai e a filha acabam se perdendo e vão parar em um lugar assustador: um banquete de um grupo estranho que assume a aparência de “animais”. Lá, os humanos são tratados como gado, e carne humana é o prato principal. Esses seres, que administram uma “fazenda de humanos”, não são exatamente animais… ou talvez algo que transcende o conceito de animalidade. Os dois estão prestes a experimentar a pior forma de “hospitalidade” imaginável. Doubutsu Ningen é uma história que desafia você a refletir sobre o significado de “comer vidas”. Um thriller de terror proibido e cheio de pesadelos sobre uma fazenda onde os papéis são invertidos.

Here I am, reincarnated into the world of Love & Magic Academy, an otome game with RPG elements, and I’m one of the love interests: cool, bespectacled Arius.
Wait. Which means… I’m going to get dragged into the romantic scenes just like in the game?!
But I have zero interest in romance. And this world isn’t just about romance scenes. It has magic and monsters, and you can raise your stats through dungeon diving.

Since I have no interest in romance, I’m going to start off by training and increasing my stats with sword and magic, then I’ll head deep into the dungeons, smashing countless monsters along the way.

**Here I go, ignoring the romance scenes as I dive into dungeons in order to get stronger!**

biography.en:
Yoshihiro Togashi (冨樫 義博, Togashi Yoshihiro, born April 27, 1966) is a Japanese manga artist. He began drawing manga at an early age; while he attended college, the publishing company Shueisha recognized his talent. Togashi has authored numerous manga series in different genres during the past three decades. He is perhaps best known for writing and illustrating the YuYu Hakusho and Hunter × Hunter series, both of which have been published in the popular Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine. Togashi is married to [Naoko Takeuchi](https://mangadex.org/author/40e66f64-a9d2-4fb3-9dc4-9e9a68e9eb9c/takeuchi-naoko), the author of Sailor Moon.

On December 24, 1997, he co wrote a book with Naoko. He drew Naoko 's work *Sailor Moon*. Naoko also drew some things that are impossible to draw normally, and there are their lip prints in the book. The note is “the Christmas gift of ‘Prince Yoshihiro’ and ’Princess Naoko’”

He has two children. At the end of December 2012, The message "my daughter is so cute" was left in *JUMP FESTA*. 

He is famous for his free imagination, story plot and complex and plump characterization. Most of his works are not limited to one style, creating a generation of ethos. He likes baseball , rock music, raising snakes and playing TV games.

Mientras tanto, en el centro de este rumor, el bar izakaya Geidontei, no hay nada fuera de lugar en lo que respecta a su comida y bebida, o incluso con respecto a su propietario.

Cuando la sacerdotisa Reimu Hakurei se entera de la situación, intenta cumplir con su deber de investigar el sospechoso establecimiento. Sin embargo, el caso la lleva a otra persona: Miyoi Okunoda, cuya existencia parece ser tan volátil como una burbuja.

description.en:
After rigorously training for three years, the ordinary Saitama has gained immense strength which allows him to take out anyone and anything with just one punch. He decides to put his new skill to good use by becoming a hero. However, he quickly becomes bored with easily defeating monsters, and wants someone to give him a challenge to bring back the spark of being a hero.  
  
Upon bearing witness to Saitama's amazing power, Genos, a cyborg, is determined to become Saitama's apprentice. During this time, Saitama realizes he is neither getting the recognition that he deserves nor known by the people due to him not being a part of the Hero Association. Wanting to boost his reputation, Saitama decides to have Genos register with him, in exchange for taking him in as a pupil. Together, the two begin working their way up toward becoming true heroes, hoping to find strong enemies and earn respect in the process.

biography.en:
**Tomohiro** or **ONE** (born October 29, 1986) is the alias of a Japanese manga artist, best known for his manga series One-Punch Man (2009–present), which is remade by Yusuke Murata. ONE serialized One-Punch Man under his own website with no official publisher. The remake is serialized in the web version of Weekly Young Jump. He is a manga artist for fun. He serialized Mob Psycho 100 in the online version of Weekly Shōnen Sunday known as Ura Sunday, which ended in December 2017.

He was born in Niigata and was brought up in Kōnosu, Saitama. When ONE was much younger he made several manga that never got serialized such as "Taiyo Man" (Sun Man) and "Tennis Player Ryu".

ONE and Yusuke Murata received the Best Manga Sugoi Japan Award 2016. The award aims to promote works that have "universality," "originality", and "potential" to be big international hits.

biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 伊藤潤二

**Birthdate:** July 31, 1963

Horror manga artist. Some of his most notable works include *Tomie*, a series chronicling an immortal girl who drives her stricken admirers to madness; Spiral Into Horror Uzumaki, a three-volume series about a town obsessed with spirals; and *Gyo*, a two-volume story where fish are controlled by a strain of sentient bacteria called "the death stench." His other works include *Itou Junji Kyoufu Manga Collection*, a collection of different short stories including a series of stories named *Souichi's Journal of Delights* and *Itou Junji's Cat Diary: Yon & Mu*, a self-parody about him and his wife living in a house with two cats. Itou's work has developed a substantial cult following, with some deeming him a significant figure in recent horror iconography.

In 2006, Junji married Ishiguro Ayako (石黒亜矢子), a picture book artist. As of 2013, they have two children.

description.en:
Tohru Yanagi, aka BYDE, is an obsessive gamer with a penchant for fantasy tropes. It should come as no surprise, then, that after playing his favorite VR game "Last Fantasy" for 100 hours straight, his heart gave out and he died. 

In the endless void after death, he met Celuenon, the god of gaming. Intrigued by his skills, Celuenon invites him to the world of Krenaklem, a land of swords and sorcery and all of those typical isekai tropes. Tohru accepts, and naturally is sent to another world. 

So what's the catch this time, you might ask? In lieu of giving him any skills from Last Fantasy, Tohru instead was gifted a deck from "Monster and Magic Masters" - a physical card game he used to play in the past. And just like the trading card game, as long as he has the required mana he can summon any card from his deck, ranging from monsters to his faithful wolfgirl assistant Waff. 

Anyway, by now you get the jist of it. If you made it to the end of this synopsis, you know exactly what you're getting into - and you've likely already committed to reading this. Don't let me stop you.

Tohru Yanagi, também conhecido como BYDE, é um gamer obcecado por clichês de fantasia. Não é de se surpreender, então, que depois de jogar seu jogo de realidade virtual favorito, "Last Fantasy", por 100 horas seguidas, seu coração tenha parado e ele tenha morrido.

No vazio infinito após a morte, ele conheceu Celuenon, o deus dos jogos. Intrigado com suas habilidades, Celuenon o convida para o mundo de Krenaklem, uma terra de espadas, feitiçaria e todos aqueles clichês típicos de isekai. Tohru aceita e, naturalmente, é enviado para outro mundo.

Então, qual é a pegadinha desta vez, você pode perguntar? Em vez de receber as habilidades de Last Fantasy, Tohru recebeu de presente um baralho de "Monster and Magic Masters" — um jogo de cartas físicas que ele costumava jogar no passado. E, assim como no jogo de cartas colecionáveis, contanto que ele tenha o mana necessário, ele pode invocar qualquer carta de seu baralho, desde monstros até sua fiel assistente lobisomem, Waff.

De qualquer forma, você já entendeu a essência. Se chegou até o final desta sinopse, sabe exatamente no que está se metendo — e provavelmente já se comprometeu a ler isto. Não deixe que eu o impeça.

“I want to kill the seven people who drove my sister to her death.”

Three years ago, Mei’s sister, Akari, was subjected to horrific bullying in this town and took her own life. Mei has returned to exact revenge. She plans to perform the blood-soaked ritual ‘Okakashitsutsumi,’ handed down at Akada Shrine, to embody the giant serpent god ‘Okakashisama’ and kill the seven people involved.

On the night of the summer solstice, Mei successfully performs the ritual. From that point on, with the power of the god and together with Shiori, Mei begins to kill those involved in her sister’s death, one by one each day. Amid their days of vengeance and escape, the two eventually develop romantic feelings for each other. However, Mei keeps one secret from Shiori: anyone who performs the ‘Okakashitsutsumi’ must ultimately offer their soul to the god, meaning Mei’s own death is inevitable.

Thiếu nữ dành cả đời để trả thù bảy kẻ sát hại chị gái mình.

 Tại Thị trấn Akada bốn bề vây quanh bởi núi non có cậu sinh viên nọ tên Nakagawa Shiori. Cậu ta vì quá chán nản với cảnh bị bắt nạt nên đã ngừng tới trường. Rồi một ngày, thiếu nữ tên Satou Mei bỗng dưng từ đâu đến sống chung với cậu. Mei là người chẳng hề mở lòng với bất kỳ ai, nhưng cô lại tiết lộ cho cậu biết lý do mà bản thân tới thị trấn này.

 “Tôi muốn giết bảy kẻ đã khiến chị tôi tuyệt vọng tới mức tìm tới cái chết.”

 Ba năm trước, chị của Mei là Akari đã tự sát vì bị bắt nạt đến thậm tệ tại thị trấn Akada này. Vì trả thù nên Mei đã quay lại đây, đồng thời cô ấy muốn thực hiện nghi thức đẫm máu mang tên “Okakashitsutsumi” nhằm sử dụng sức mạnh của Đại Xà Thần “Okakashisama” để đồ sát bảy kẻ tham gia vào vụ việc.

 Vào đêm hạ chí tháng Sáu, Mei đã thành công thực hiện nghi thức. Giờ đây, nhờ thứ sức mạnh của thần linh cùng sự trợ giúp của Shiori, Mei lần lượt sát hại bảy kẻ đã giết chị mình. Trong khoảng thời gian trả thù và chạy trốn ấy, Mei và Shiori đã rơi vào lưới tình của nhau. Tuy nhiên, có một điều mà Mei không hề nói với Shiori: bất kỳ ai thực hiện nghi thức “Okakashitsutsumi” đều phải dâng hiến linh hồn của bản thân cho thần linh, vậy nên số phận của Mei đã định sẽ phải chết.
Bản dịch sơ lược lấy từ Novel do Mep dịch.
